Analysis of a keg-emblazoned basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.  It is currently tier 4 of 5, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A keg-emblazoned basket has 2 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.
Alterations:
The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.
Basket's Blanket: a niveous warg fur blanket
It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a bar-topped carved ko'nag table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.
The keg-emblazoned basket will cost 999,999,900 coins.

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.

You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.

items.name: a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen

raw: A faint crimson sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            V'tull
Deity Primary Color:              Red-lined black
Deity Secondary Color:            Crimson
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 8,500,000 coins.

Analysis of a small wicker basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.  It is currently tier 5 of 5, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A small wicker basket has 1 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.

The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.

It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a rough oak table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
SPECIAL TABLEWARE UNLOCK

Because your basket has been unlocked to the 5th tier, you are now able to add utensils, plates, saucers, or napkins with special certificates.  To see which you already have installed, please GAZE at the basket.
In Basket Form:
WHISPER - To obtain a single copy of the item.
GAZE    - To see the full list of unlocked tableware items.
In Table Form:
Upon becoming a table, your tableware items will be stacked on the table.
GET will allow you, or anyone using your table, to obtain a tableware item.

All tableware items are marked as junk to allow you to throw them away when you are near trash barrels.  This includes the trash basket stored under your table when it is out.  Throwing away a tableware item does not destroy those contained in your basket.

Please Note:  A tableware voucher is your gateway to customizing your tableware items.  Once the tableware is installed in your Basketifier, it cannot be altered by a merchant.  However, you can purchase a new voucher, customize it, and then override your current design.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.

The auction block can be altered freely as long as it still reflects being some sort of flat container with an interior and flat upper surface for displaying items for examination.

To run an auction: PUT the prize(s) (if desired) on the auction block for your customers to INSPECT and ANALYZE.

raw: Crafted in a Tehir style, the nakaten bears a minimal pommel and stirrups that hang down at a middling length.

Analysis of a yierka hide nakaten with linen-wrapped pommel rings indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--------- TIU & QAITEKE LIZARD SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This nakaten is a Tiu & Qaiteke saddle meant for use with "lizard" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this nakaten:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target lizard} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are:  RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are: RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, SLIDE, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the nakaten.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description for future-forward accessory use that temporarily changes the long description.

Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.  Currently, the pommel ring is set up as double, which CAN be swapped out (between single and double) by willing merchants.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to nakaten (Tehir).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  It has a flat, wide seat, a minimal pommel, and no gullet.  Instead of a horn, it has a "pommel ring(s)" -- either a single upright ring or double outward angled rings that jut out from the pommel area.  It has a high, back-angled cantle with a fantail.  The strap system includes forward and rear girth straps that connect via the legs and front of the chest.  Saddle blanket ("nakatela" in Tehir) use is common, and pads are never used.  It is heavy compared to other saddle styles.
The yierka hide nakaten will cost 2,000,000 coins.

This is a tier 4 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned

Analysis of a dark-banded haon device indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)
2. TAP the Paint-in-ator to determine how many doses you want to retrieve (options: 1 - 5)
3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!
But wait!  There's more!  If you aren't satisfied with the plain, the boring, or the OFF-the-SHELF Paint-in-ator, then you can obtain an UNLOCK certificate for better convenience and goodness!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), pour (adds paint to device), pull (removes crystal amulet from device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), and turn (provides paint)
The "Paint-in-ator 3000" is Tier 1 (OTS) of 2.

Altering Instructions:  The Paint-in-ator must always be a box of some kind and must always be belt-worn.  Due to its complicated (patent pending) dials, chambers, switches, and toggles, it can never support a SHOW DESCRIPTION, but it can handle long descriptions.

Disclaimers:  The Paint-in-ator is a sensitive device and as such its creators wish to remind you that it is made for good fun.  As a result, it has restrictions on it to prevent the harm of small children and animals.  The creators do not want any accusations of "The Paint-in-ator ate my baby!"  Please be sure to always use the Paint-in-ator appropriately.  Drinking while using the Paint-in-ator forfeits all warranties, guarantees, and most lacquers.  Do not place your hands in the device while it is in use, as the creators will not be held responsible for missing digits.  And, for the love of all that is holy, do not bring a knife anywhere near it.  Do not use in the bath, as the creators will not be held responsible for what may happen.  For your safety, do not break these rules.

Analysis of a small wicker basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.  It is currently tier 4 of 5, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A small wicker basket has 1 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.
Alterations:
The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.
Basket's Blanket: a fringed red and black cloth
It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a rough oak table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.
The wicker basket will cost 3,000,000 coins.

items.name: a dark purple sunset garnet bauble with a coppery sheen

raw: Secured along the back of the bauble is a slender, hand blown crystal vial bearing a delicate stopper.
The bauble can be worn anywhere on the body.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a dark purple sunset garnet bauble with a coppery sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The sunset garnet bauble is a piece of perfume-holding jewelry that currently holds 50 doses of the scent of white freesia, oud, saffron, persimmon, and galbanum:

First-person: You have an airy effusion of scent about you, light with florals and spice, fruit and fresh green notes.  White freesia flows in delicate streams through persimmon, allusive of sweetened dough and cinnamon.  The currents wind down into a puissant heart of oud and saffron, warm and earthy as if bathed in sunlight.  Galbanum envelops the finish, tying the preceeding notes together with a fresh, green spice.

Third-person: Brodega has an airy effusion of scent about him, light with florals and spice, fruit and fresh green notes.  White freesia flows in delicate streams through persimmon, allusive of sweetened dough and cinnamon.  The currents wind down into a puissant heart of oud and saffron, warm and earthy as if bathed in sunlight.  Galbanum envelops the finish, tying the preceeding notes together with a fresh, green spice.
When applied via PULL, this bauble will apply the scent with gendered messaging.  RUB will always be gender neutral.

It may be altered with a long or a show, but must remain a piece of jewelry.  The stoppered crystal vial will always remain on the piece.  Please note that acceptable jewelry items are only items worn as pins, around the neck, on the arm (like a vambrace), or on the wrist.  No back pendants, no anklets, no earrings.
The sunset garnet bauble will cost 500,000 coins.

--------- DISGUISE ELIXIR ITEM - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This is a Disguise Elixir item.  Depending on its setup, it will change the appearance of the race, culture, and/or gender of a character.  This is a temporary effect -- not a permanent change.
This item provides an aesthetic disguise without any mechanical benefits.  It is Tier 1 (of 2 currently).

The necklet has 10 charges remaining.  The item will NOT crumble when it is used up.  Any willing merchant can recharge the item to have a maximum of 10 charges; some less frequent merchants may be able to recharge higher than that.

Each charge on this necklet nets the character roughly 8 hours and 0 minutes of disguise time until the disguise is eliminated (either through naturally running its course, removing the item prematurely via PULL).  There is a very rare chance during each charge cycle that the disguise will prematurely end on its own well before the full time has elapsed.  Also note that death automatically ousts the disguise from a character.

The necklet is set up to place the following aesthetic attributes on a character.  Altering these settings may only be done on rare occasions by qualified persons; it is not a general merchant service.
Race: Sylvankind
Currently you are able to try to PUSH (to activate), PULL (to deactivate), LICK, and RUB (toggles item's visibility while active) the necklet.

Aesthetic alterations to the item itself are acceptable -- they just must make sense for where the item is worn.  Note that needles come out of the underside of the item, so nothing in the alteration should prevent that from logically occurring.

Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.

LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 525,000 coins.

Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.

Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/topaz-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed. Back and shoulder containers: 160 pounds

This pink note can be REDEEMed to increase the capacity of a worn container (back, shoulder, slung on shoulder, torso, attached to belt, and front) by 10 pounds.  Containers worn in other locations are not eligible for this note.

Please note that in some cases, this increase may change your item from non-functional to functional.  In addition, any items restricted to hold a specific number of items (ie: your container will only hold one item) will still only hold X number of items.  This note will not change that.  Normal restrictions will apply and may vary from item to item.
Some scripted items are eligible for redemption with this pink note.
A light pink note is a single-use note.
HUG your note to see a list of denied scripts.

items.name: a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork

raw: The yoke is constructed of layers of carmine brocade and looks like it will span the shoulders and taper down the front of the torso.  Four rows of four faceted glyphs form the yoke's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  At the moment, all of the glyphs appear dull and lifeless.
It is estimated that a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork can store a small amount with enough space for a couple of items.
The yoke can be worn over the front.  The yoke appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of leather, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the yoke and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/glyph-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "glyph-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the yoke refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the yoke CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the glyph-adorned yoke, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a small statue.
This is a Tier 1 yoke, with four tiers in total.  This yoke is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Glyph Adorned Baldric
This yoke CANNOT be deepened at all.
The glyph-adorned yoke will cost 175,000 coins.

~*~ Nervestaves ~*~
SCRIPT DETAILS
The staff has a mechanical (combat) script which provides three basic types of functionality that can be broken down into the following categories:
AFFINITY:

- A special, custom 'bonding' like mechanism.  Any given item can share an Affinity with only one person at a time.  Affinity is gained by wielding the item and landing successful hits against like level foes.
- At T4, affinity is increased and decreased at twice the rate of T1-3.
- At T5, affinity is increased at 3x the rate of T1-3.  Decreasing matches T4.  Once a month, the affinity can be reset to 0.
- At T6, affinity matches T5.  Affinity resets can be performed at will.
BACKLASH:

- Potential negative effects, including immobilization, stuns, and nervous system damage, that can occur at random.  As the wielder's Affinity with the item grows, the chance of a Backlash occurring are reduced.
FLARES:

- Off-the-Shelf, this item comes with a 'Muscle Memory' flare that, when triggered, will temporarily enhance the wielder's Combat Maneuver Ranks.  The magnitude of the enhancement is based on the degree of Affinity shared with the wielder, while the frequency of the flare is determined by the item's tier.

- Unlocked items also possess the potential for an offensive 'Misery Unleashed' flare.  This flare can ONLY be triggered when the item is wielded against like level foes by someone with whom a COMPLETE Affinity is shared.
TIERS 5 AND 6 INFO:

- T5: Can toggle your staff via PROD to use an SMR defense bonus instead (+5), can use RAISE to 'eat' an existing SMR or CM bonus for a one-cast AS/CS increase (+25/+15, 10-second cooldown for MM after), has a 25% chance to fire a 2nd misery flare (and if obtained, a 12% chance for the 3rd to flare)

- T6:  At max affinity, CM bonus increases to +20 at max affinity and SMR defense bonus increases to +10.  Also, the one-cast AS/CS boost increases (+50/+30), can WAVE staff once every 3 minutes for an AOE misery flare (all 3 flavors will fire).
- NOTE:  The Muscle Memory SMR 'flare' will activate at a standard flare rate, not the enhanced CM rate.
ITEM DETAILS
This is a tiered item that is currently Tier 2 of 6, which results in a 25% chance for the Muscle Memory flare to trigger when used against like level foes.
Fluff Verbs:  clench, touch, and stare.

The braided staff shares a considerable Affinity with someone, but it isn't with you!  This will result in a bonus of 5 to Combat Maneuver Ranks being applied when the Muscle Memory flare is successfully triggered.
Using this item in combat against like level foes will decrease the Affinity Level.
ALTERATION GUIDELINES

This braided staff may be freely altered by any merchant who is comfortable doing so, with the following caveat:  The staff was formed of special saplings that were trained to grow around one another.  In order to reflect this, it should either contain a word like 'twisted', 'braided', 'helical', or something similiar *OR* at least not contradict this origin.

Tips for non-wood nerve staves:  You should assume that at its core, there are special saplings twisted around one another.  SHOWs that have language such as the metal wrapping around the wood, etc. can maintain the intent of a nerve stave's origins.
~*~ End Custom Analyze ~*~

raw: A heavy black linen harness embroidered with swans in flight made of fine black linen and tied into elaborate knotwork is designed to be worn on the left hip and is easily able to be attached to armor or a belt.  Secured by the elaborate knotwork are two scabbards.  The first, a silver-lipped black leather scabbard, is set for a quick draw, and the other, an ebon-rimmed ivory leather scabbard, is positioned slightly behind and at a slight angle down.

~ KWTS Sashes ~
KWTS Sashes (also known as "Greame" sashes) will hold only weapons that are katanas, kozukas, wakizashis, tantos, or sais.
Verb Traps:  clench, look, pull, push, read, rub, tap, tilt, and turn
Alteration Instructions:
* Must be a harness, sash, or vatanura
* Must be a soft cloth (silk, linen, etc.), and no leather/suede/metals, for example

* It also supports a custom loresong, which is a rare service, but if you won one, this allows for it
You can tell that the harness is as light as it can get, but you might be able to have a talented merchant deepen its pockets for you.
The black linen harness will cost 3,000,000 coins.

Analysis of an intricate silver toothkey set with a mother-of-pearl handle indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Tooth Extracter --
This silver toothkey is an instrument designed to extract teeth from certain dead creatures.
If unlocked, player teeth can also be extracted once a day (with consent).
Extracted teeth/fangs can be used in the Weaving system.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* The 15/15/15, long, and show of this silver toothkey can be freely altered as long as they follow all guidelines.
* The only approved nouns for this toothkey are "pelican" or "toothkey".

* These instruments include a hooked "claw" that slips around the tooth, a "bolster" that rests against the opposite side of the tooth as a fulcrum, and a handle that is usually ring-shaped.  The Elanthian versions additionally include a small crank to tighten the claw against the bolster.
* The claw should be made of metal and can have a custom material and custom descriptor.
* The handle can be made of anything hard (metal, wood, bone, porcelain, mother-of-pearl, etc.) and can have a custom material and a custom descriptor.
* Any merchant comfortable with this script can change the custom settings, but these should generally be changed to match the alteration.
==Features==
* Extract Weaveable Creature Teeth/Fangs
POINT the silver toothkey at an appropriate dead creature, TURN to select the tooth you want, and then PULL to extract the tooth.
POINT the silver toothkey with no target to clear the selection.
Each creature extraction gives you a bundle of 2 teeth that can be used in the Weaving system.  Each creature can only be extracted from once.
Different creatures will have different-looking teeth.  Possible types of teeth: tooth, canine tooth (or fang), incisor, molar (or carnassial).  Not all creatures have all types.
The adjective of the created tooth will be the creature's name, but you can toggle this appearing by using PUSH on the silver toothkey.
* Extract Player Teeth [Unlocked]
Once a day you can extract a Weaveable tooth from a player using the same method as is used for creatures.
The player must be alive and must give CONSENT.  This action will injure and stun them.
This will give you only a single tooth.
* Fluff Actions [Tier 2 of 2]

Extra fluff actions let you perform examinations on player or creature teeth so you are better able to diagnose any potential dental issues.  Rooting around in a player's mouth, even without extracting a tooth, requires CONSENT.
At this tier, your silver toothkey captures:

POINT (targeted - select a player/creature to examine), POINT (untargeted - clear any current selection), TURN (switch to a different tooth type of the current target), PUSH (toggle whether adjective appears in created tooth), PULL (extract currently selected tooth), POKE (targeted/untargeted), PINCH (targeted/untargeted), PONDER (targeted/untargeted), CLEAN.
==Current Settings==
* Claw Material: silver
* Claw Descriptor: curved
* Handle Material: mother-of-pearl
* Handle Descriptor: smooth

raw: A faint silver sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.

This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            No deity
Deity Primary Color:              Grey
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

The auction block can be used as a tool and prop for setting up your own auctions and raffles.
The auction block is UNLOCKED to run raffles.
Alteration Guidelines:
The auction block can be altered freely as long as it still reflects being some sort of flat container with an interior and flat upper surface for displaying items for examination.
A gavel is used for messaging which can also be altered, but it must remain a "gavel" and cannot have a long or show.
The two raffle table props, the tickets, and barrel, can also be altered.  However, they, too, must keep the noun "tickets" and "barrel" and cannot have shows or longs.
Usage:
To run an auction: PUT the prize(s) (if desired) on the auction block for your customers to INSPECT and ANALYZE.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between runner-up and non-runner up modes.
BID <amount> block to set the starting bid amount.
POUND the block to begin bidding!
Bidders should BID <amount> block to up their bids.
POKE the block to announce the current bid and progress through once, twice, three times.
POUND the block to end bidding.
The winning bidder will get five minutes to return with a note large enough to cover their bid, after which DROPping it in the block will give them the prize(s) you have placed on top (if any).
To run a raffle, PULL the auction block to place tickets and a raffle barrel on top of the auction block.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between one ticket per customer or multiple tickets allowed.
TURN the auction block to select which line of credit to store your raffle proceeds in.
WRITE ticket;prize <description> to set the description on the tickets.
WRITE ticket;price # to set the cost of each ticket.
Wait until tickets have been collected in the barrel.
Up to 99 tickets can be purchased.
SPIN the barrel to draw a name.
SPIN the barrel more times to draw more names.
If any tickets have been purchased, you must SPIN the barrel at least once before you can stop the raffle.
The list of winners can be reviewed by LOOKing at the tickets.
CLEAN the barrel after SPINning to reset the raffle.
Please note that for raffles, the winner will not automatically receive any prizes on the table.  You must deliver them manually.
The profit will be placed inside the block as a note you can extract later.
Try as you might, you cannot get a good sense of whether or not the block's pockets could get any deeper, but you can tell that the block is as light as it can get.
The auction block will cost 100,000,000 coins.

items.name: a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen

raw: A faint crimson sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct red-lined black battle standard with a rippling crimson sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

This Unlock Certificate applies an improvement or service as described below.  It may not be changed in any way.

This Unlock Certificate applies an improvement or service as described below.  It may not be changed in any way.

Usage:  APPRAISE       Check eligibility
REDEEM         Apply the improvement
A timeworn location swatch grants the ability to change the worn location of an unscripted, wearable item.
DETAILS:
> Armaments are ineligible, with the exception of greaves.
> DB items, EZ Scripted items, and items with Flourishes are ineligble.
> Arm and leg greaves may only swap between the Arms (14) and Legs (15) locations.
> Only containers can be processed as a container, and they must be empty at the time of redemption.
> Container capacities will not increase (only decrease or be removed).
> Pockets are removed if a container becomes a non-container or is changed to a location that does not
support containers.
> The resulting noun is dictated by the new worn location and original item properties.  Only wood and
metal items can be processed as wood and metal, respectively.
> Locations with only base and container nouns will change non-leather items to cloth.
> Non-leather containers, socks, undershirts, and leggings will be changed to cloth.
> Items that are organic or lacking a material will be handled as non-metal and be changed to cloth,
with the exception of greaves, which default to plain metal.
> The resulting base/long description generally follows "a/an/some <material> <noun>."
> Wood and metal items that change to cloth will have their material preserved based on the resulting
noun, such as "<material>-brimmed" for hats.
> Show descriptions will be removed.
> Use LOOK        to view the current settings and preview a held item's changes (if applicable).
> Use TILT        to toggle processing a container as a container.    Currently: Yes
> Use TURN [to #] to toggle to the next or a specific worn location.  Currently: PIN

raw: Designed with practicality in mind, the chatelaine offers both utility and elegance.  Anchored by an embossed hook plate, several finely crafted braided sterling silver chains hold essential tools.  Among them are a mother-of-pearl inlaid scissor sheath and a rose-filigreed silver nail file sheath, ensuring quick access and secure storage.  Dangling from a length of chain is a wren-capped clip that is intended to house a thimble, while a lacquered birch eyeglass case keeps spectacles conveniently within reach.  Additional rings and chains are fashioned to secure a keyring while a small, metallic lobster claw clip is engineered to support a single key.

This particular flypaper is fully customized and ready to be placed on your body.  You may FLIP it until you find a suitable location for the tattoo, or RAISE it to tattoo yourself.

Rivets and tiny screws are rendered in and out of the shadows, with some of the tiny fixtures haloed in shiny illustrated light.  Trapped within the lens is the image of a tropical island surrounded by a cobalt blue sea.  Frothy waves cascade across its sandy shores, while an unseen breeze tugs at the fan-like leaves of its palm trees.

(Clench): "Bunching your shoulders, the muscles in your back ripple, causing the polished lens of your brass spyglass tattoo to appear more pronounced."

raw: The baldric is constructed of layers of storm grey suede and looks like it would be worn cross-torso from shoulder to hip.  Four rows of two faceted glyphs form the baldric's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting. Analysis of a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/ivory-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "ivory-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the baldric refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the baldric CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the ivory-adorned baldric, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a white crystal.
This is a Tier 3 baldric, with four tiers in total.  This baldric is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.

raw: The lid of this oak case has been exquisitely painted, depicting dramatic colorful scenery from one corner to the other.  Two of the four sides are adorned with large, rounded enamel moons, one faintly luminescent, while the other is tinted in hazy dark hues.  A half-moon, painted in muted yellow tones, is depicted on a third side.  In elegant script, the words "Lornon" and "Liabo" have been inked beneath each of the orbs, while no lettering exists beneath the half-moon.  The Liabo moon is completely flush with the side of the case.
It is estimated that a smooth oak case can store a very small amount with enough space for one item.
The case can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of wood, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a smooth oak case indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This oak case (also known as an Arkati Box) can have either a short or a long description, but cannot support a show, as one already exists.  It must also remain some kind of container that would have a lid/top.  The case is currently at Tier 2 and has the following verbs available: PUSH, POKE, TOUCH, TURN, RUB, CLEAN, GAZE, OPEN, CLOSE, LOOK and PUT.  Though the case may not be unlocked further, if you win a raffle version, you could opt to have your current case adjusted to the raffle tier.  Your case is aligned to: Liabo.  This was first released at Ebon Gate 2014 in Go Figure, owned by Bisha.
Try as you might, you cannot get a good sense of whether or not the case's pockets could get any deeper, but you can tell that the case is as light as it can get.
The oak case will cost 100,000 coins.

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.

- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification
You may also use CLEAN to remove this script from the item, or use DUST to remove its long description, turning it into a stiff thrak hide knapsack.
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the thrak hide knapsack for you or deepen its pockets.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for River's Rest currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the River's Rest chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for Ta'Illistim currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the Ta'Illistim chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 250,000 coins.

---- Animalistic Spirit Armor ----
=General Script Information=
This is armor with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, or successfully evading them during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When the wearer is hit, the armor has a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct, which can knockdown the attacker and disorient them momentarily.
If used with an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and also add the weapon/shield's Animalistic Fury flares to the response.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this armor are fine.
* Any merchant can change the associated Armor Accents to match the alteration.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Instinct Flares (Tier 4 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out defensively with a maneuver-based sonic attack, causing knockdown and roundtime.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and will add Animalistic Fury flares.
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked
On a successful evade, there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield with Revenge unlocked, there is a chance the armor will call for aid to add Animalistic Fury flares.
* Bestial Barrier = Unlocked
When Animalistic Instinct flares hit, the spirit within shares some of its strength to defend you, causing an increase to your DS for 30 seconds or until the next attack.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Feral Whirlwind = Locked
Once an hour, direct the spirit within to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares against 3 to 5 creatures in the room in a single sonic attack by STOMPing the chain.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Untamed Vitality = Locked
Once an hour, draw on the vitality of the spirit within your armor for an increase in a combination of Health, Mana, and/or Stamina Recovery by CLENCHing the chain.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 1 of 3)
At this tier, this armor captures the following: WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Flares On/Off), WHISTLE.
Use PROD to make the spirit less visible while using these actions [Spirit is currently: Awake]

items.name: a tapered turquoise jewel banded in cool gradients

raw: A mirage-like haze of arcane influence clings to the jewel, alight with half-glimpsed glyphs refracting across its facets from within.  The effect is dizzying and makes further visual inspection difficult.
The jewel appears to be a powerful relic that can convey wondrous abilities on its wielder.  It has the following property:
Rarity:      Common
Mnemonic:    ephemera
Description: The following spells have 20/40/60/80/100% higher duration: 117, 140, 240, 506, 515, 605, 919, 1608, 1619.

The jewel can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.
The turquoise jewel will cost 2,345,678 coins.

ALTERATION GUIDELINES

Panel's Appearance: No long or show descriptions, noun must remain panel, article/adjective must describe an image and make sense as both art/adj/panel and art/adj/illusion (do not reference materials).

Concealed Illusion: A skilled merchant may alter the concealed illusion.  Supported customizations include article/adjective, custom long description (noun must remain illusion), and "show" descriptions.  Keep in mind that the illusion itself is a magical creation that is intangible and very obviously an illusion.  These are guidelines, and the merchant always has the final say over what they can or cannot do.

Illusion Color: Must be one or two words that are simple and obvious representations of color.  Avoid words that could be mistaken for an object or that qualify the color's properties.  The chosen color must make sense when describing magical illusion energy.  Great choices include: white, crimson, cerulean, viridian, periwinkle, or colorful.  Avoid words like: lemon, iridescent blue, faded grey, terracotta, or copper.

Illusion Material: Must be a word or short phrase that describes the temporary form taken by the magical illusion energy.  Must always be plural.  Must not reference color in any way.  Any adjectives describing the material MUST occur after a color adjective when considering rules for adjective-order.  In many of the illusion style messages, the illusion color directly precedes illusion material and so they must make adjective-order sense.  The material options that make the most sense will often be light, airy, individually distinct, transparent, and/or reflective.  Great choices include: motes of light, bubbles, ethereal leaves, water droplets, smoke wisps, or sparks.

List Customizations: These customizations are chosen as a number from a pre-made list: Illusion Style, Gesture Style, and Illusion Modifier.  Not all options are available at every merchant.  You must provide any dye additive in addition to the service fee when requesting an Illusion Modifier.  Here is the list of gesture styles: 0-subtle 1-complex 2-comical 3-abrupt 4-flamboyant 5-exaggerated 6-muted 7-stiff 8-formal 9-lazy 10-graceful 11-sharp 12-disjointed 13-angular 14-careful 15-wild 16-sweeping

Tier 2:  Augmented Recovery

This is a prize token that, once REDEEMed, will:
Grant the ability to cast a customized Miracle (350) involving ethereal forms.

First Person: Slinking across the ground, a band of mist slips into the area and encircles your prone form.  Rising like specters from within the blanket of humid air, ethereal forms begin to take shape.  As they move across you, you can't help but notice that they appear to look like you and wear expressions that range from mirth to rage, sorrow to joy, and everything in between.  One by one, they jump into your mouth, and you feel a jolt enliven you, but as the last disappears, you feel the breath of life return.

Others' View: Slinking across the ground, a band of mist slips into the area and slowly encircles Brodega's prone form.  Several ethereal forms rise out of the blanket of humid air, each looking like a smaller version of Brodega and wearing expressions that range from mirth to sorrow, rage to calm, and everything in between.  One by one, they march in procession across his body and jump into his slack, lifeless lips.  With each addition, a jolt courses through him, and as they enter, he gasps with the breath of life.
Important note:
The effect of this token is cosmetic.  It does not increase the effect or damage caused by a spell.

This item does NOT grant spell knowledge.  REDEEMing this item assumes that the player already has the ability to cast the customized spell either from an item, Spell Knowledge, or having the spell cast upon you, if applicable.

items.name: a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen

raw: A faint black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
